statements.t: We anticipate substantially integrating the WSUT business into the Tidewater platform by the start of 2027.
We are updating our 2026 revenue guidance range of $1.43 billion to $1.44 billion and our 2026 gross margin guidance range of 47.5% to 48.5%.
We expect continued elevated operating costs associated with the conflict in the Middle East that we now anticipate to impact the fourth quarter.
We expect to incur approximately $19.8 million in conflict-related costs in 2026, approximately $8.7 million of which we are contractually permitted to bill back to our customers.
As such, we are initiating full-year 2027 revenue guidance of $1.70 to $1.75 billion and full-year 2027 margin guidance of 51% to 53%.”
